problem.title: Explicit (non-existential) channels violating multiplicativity of maximal output p-norm for p not equal to 1

question.summary: The source asked for explicitly given channels, not random existence arguments, violating multiplicativity of the maximal output p-norm at some p different from 1. The Werner-Holevo channel already supplies one for p above 4.79, and Cubitt, Harrow, Leung, Montanaro and Winter later gave an explicit 4-to-3 pair at p = 0.
question.importance: The post-Werner-Holevo counterexamples of Winter and Hayden are existential random constructions that exhibit no concrete channel, whereas explicit channels are valuable for testing related conjectures, for numerical experimentation, for structural understanding of how entanglement boosts output purity, and for pedagogy.

problem.titleMarkdown: Explicit channels violating multiplicativity of maximal output $p$-norm for $p\ne 1$

targetClauses.label: Explicit multiplicativity-violating channels
targetClauses.text: The archived statement asks for explicit quantum channels, with concretely given Kraus operators or Stinespring isometry in finite dimensions, that violate multiplicativity of the maximal output p-norm at some p different from 1, rather than mere instances of the random existence theorems of Winter and Hayden.
targetClauses.resolutionCriteria: An explicitly written-down channel or channel pair whose multiplicativity violation can be verified directly.

claims.title: Werner-Holevo channel is an explicit multiplicativity counterexample
claims.text: The Werner-Holevo channel is an explicitly given qutrit channel that violates multiplicativity of the maximal output p-norm for p above 4.79, which already meets the archived request for a concrete example at some p different from 1. Cubitt, Harrow, Leung, Montanaro and Winter later gave an explicit 4-to-3 channel pair with nonmultiplicative minimum output rank at p = 0.

evidence.sourceLocator: Explicit qutrit channel violating multiplicativity for p > 4.79
evidence.label: Journal of Mathematical Physics

evidence.sourceLocator: Explicit 4-to-3 channel pair with nonmultiplicative minimum output rank at p = 0
evidence.label: Communications in Mathematical Physics

decisions.rationale: The archived statement asks only for explicit channels violating multiplicativity at some p different from 1, without requiring modest dimension or coverage near p = 1, and the peer-reviewed Werner-Holevo channel supplies exactly that.

cautions.label: Scope
cautions.text: For p just above 1 and for 0 < p < 1 no truly small-dimension explicit channel is known; a 2025/2026 preprint by Derksen and Lovitz (arXiv:2510.07547) gives constructive examples for every p > 1 including the difficult interval near one, which strengthens but is not needed for the existential statement.
